Beast-Reared

Whether raised, rescued or apprenticed among beasts, you know a world of scent and posture.

Which animal behavior do you still find reassuring?

Rules

Choose one:

- Wilderness 1 and @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.d38c652a345c2386.JournalEntryPage.0656c6b3573be88f]{Borrow the Beast}. - Calling 1 and @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.9f93d2da6ba8b151.JournalEntryPage.24bc33170c2d1abe]{Summon Animal — Novice}.

Type: Background

Each option is a pair. Duplicate grants give 1 level-0 DP each; no automatic higher rank. Follow the card’s equipment grant.

Starting coin contribution: +5 coins. See @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.0558be1f6014ee71.JournalEntryPage.880380bcd80cfec6]{starting coins}.
